prior_summary: Completion-predicate local insertion prior: a learned state-conditioned DDPM action policy uses drawer-frame blue error, red-pad/drawer-open/blue-inside predicate features, and auxiliary future-completion supervision to center/release the blue block in the open drawer and retreat.
applicable_conditions: Use when the drawer is already open, the red block is on or very near the outside pad, and the blue block/TCP are in the late transport-to-drawer region: from high carried blue near x about -0.18, y 0.065-0.08, z about 0.32 with closed fingers through the lower release and retreat phase. The causal observations must include qpos/qvel, TCP pose, red pose, blue pose, drawer position/velocity, and red/blue goals.
termination_guidance: The task may be declared complete at any observation satisfying drawer_position > 0.26, red center on the outside pad, and blue center inside the drawer cavity with z in the specified open interval. For skill-level safety, continue briefly after first completion if the gripper is still near or touching the blue block; demonstrations end with fingers open and TCP retreated upward around z 0.323 m.
limitations: This policy is trained only on the assigned expanded late slice and is not a recovery policy for a blue block dropped outside the drawer. It does not implement analytic IK, image processing, hard constraints, or a scripted sampler guidance controller; predicate information is represented through learned conditioning and differentiable auxiliary losses.
